sidecar_purpose: Document the canonical source image for the Bit/Bot mechanic hero pose in the bot role kit.
source_truth_note: The image pixels and filename are the source of truth; descriptive text is derived from visual inspection.
runtime_use_note: Suitable as a style reference, prompt anchor, and asset catalog entry for the mechanic role.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer canonical backstory, environment, or motion beyond the visible frame; exact provenance is unknown.

provenance.prompt_unretained_note: Provenance has not been determined for this image.

summary: Hero source image of Bit/Bot in the mechanic role, posed with a hammer and wearing a blue and white work uniform, cap, and tool pocket.

composition: Single full-figure hero pose against a plain white background.
Bot is centered, facing the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn.
One hand holds a hammer; the other rests on a tool pocket.
character_design: White and blue rounded robot head with large blue glowing eyes and a friendly smile.
White work cap with a dark patch showing a wrench icon.
Dark blue mechanic jacket with rolled sleeves, white gloves, and a 'BOT' chest nameplate.
White panel torso with a blue belt and matching blue wheel hubs.
props_and_role_markers: Wooden-handled hammer held upright in the right hand.
Pocket on the jacket holds a screwdriver and a wrench.
Wrench icon patch repeated on the cap and jacket pocket.

positive_constraints: Use this image as the canonical mechanic hero reference for Bit/Bot.
Preserve the blue and white color scheme, wrench iconography, and tool props.
Keep the friendly, confident pose and neutral white background for source-image use.
negative_constraints: Do not change the robot's core body shape, wheel base, or face style.
Do not use this single source image as final art acceptance without image QA.
Do not introduce additional story, environment, or characters not shown.

best_for: Prompting new mechanic-themed images of Bit/Bot.

Asset catalog and role kit indexing.
